name: And the Haze Will Take Us
source:
The gods are long gone, and your village is shrouded in a deadly fog. You are accustomed to the secrets of your home and its silence, but when you feel the Haze calling to you, everything changes.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/And_the_Haze_Will_Take_Us]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
众神早已不复存在，你的村庄笼罩在致命的迷雾之中。你已经习惯了家中的秘密和寂静，但当你感觉到雾霾在召唤你时，一切都改变了。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/And_the_Haze_Will_Take_Us]romance-club.fandom[/url]
